R1 full_serial_continuous@1.0.0: numerical 6/6 pass, but quantitative position 0/6, speed 3/6, vector 2/6 → local quantitative fails. Direction 6/6 resolved and correct, but that alone is insufficient; no ranking-only bypass. So R1 does not yield a useful forecast: full-order serial continuous physics retains endpoint discrepancy from the backend's finite-step implicit dynamics (position errors ~1e-2 to 5e-2 m at task level, position_error gate 1e-6).

R2 full_serial_discrete@2.0.0: primary preregistered .0005 step reproduces backend endpoints (predicted=observed, position/speed/vector 6/6 pass) — this is backend-equivalent emulation, correctly labeled not independent validation. But at the original numerical criterion, 3/6 cases fail: shared_first (speed 1.46e-3), early_original075 (velocity 2.4e-4), holding_original075 (speed 1.1e-4), and finer .000125 comparisons likewise exceed thresholds, showing the discretization is not converged relative to the required numerical tolerance. Those same three cases lose resolved direction (indeterminate), giving only 3/6 resolved-correct. R2's endpoint "match" is achieved by construction (emulating the same step), so it cannot substitute for the numerical-resolution test, and it cannot be relabeled as convergence or as reduced/free validation.

Hence no revision satisfies joint "local quantitative AND numerical support." R1 has numerical but not quantitative; R2 has quantitative reproduction but not numerical resolution. The direction/threshold rule (6/6 correct resolved) is met only by R1, not R2.

No ranking-only bypass: despite honest full-order labeling, the pipeline fails admission.

Economics: primary pair economics positive:false (all-in screening 496.079 s, no validated savings); matched pair is a single common-state cold-init matched hypothesis (gap 2.11 N), scope explicitly limited, not full-history discrimination. Abstention avoids zero—the original pair abstained (eligibility unresolved both), so zero validated savings. Positive all-in counterfactual benefit is not established for the required two-candidate pair before any backend validation.

Real-time: measured complete update 17.9–19.5 s vs .01 s deadline; removing graph/model construction still exceeds .01 s (measured obstruction). Prior incumbent 35/35 and failed batch 70/70 misses retained; no new real backend admitted. Deadline cannot be met offline.

Prospective/repeatability: none. Repeatability untested; no prospective series; no independent backend evaluations (0). These are missing-evidence categories distinct from the scientific failure, but they independently block admission.

Therefore readiness NO_GO. Milestone5 remains open; incumbent/M2-4 retained. Limitations: development-only; full-state backend-step reproduction distinct from physical-world validation/convergence; no family-wide or safety claim; local cost lower bounds; single matched state; outcomes consumed retrospectively; holding_weights carried unchanged as historical selection, not re-optimized here.

I'll keep around 650 words. Let me count roughly. Need to be under. It's fine.
